notes: The document is a PhD dissertation (Univ. of Missouri, 2014), so not_primary applies although I1 to I5 are all met on its own data. H2 uptake is measured by the 10LSS mass-flow method and by a Hiden HTP1-V volumetric analyzer on a KOH-activated corn-cob carbon (BET 2700 m2/g), at 296 K up to about 100 bar; H2 isotherms to 200 bar at 296 K on 3K-3/3/10A and HS;0B are also shown (Figures 9, 10, 39). Table 6 H2 values are copied or derived from another thesis (Beckner), not counted for I1. Most of the thesis concerns methane and natural gas. The thesis does not state that its H2 uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data is not applied. record.json has is_retracted false and no retraction notice was found in the text.
